workflow.description: S14c We Talked About This (bản da đen) — phần 4/5: sản phẩm, gửi link, con trai ngửi, lời cược. Trước khi chạy, tải ảnh vào: IMG_ACA_TOWEL = ảnh thật (xem doc mục 2); IMG_BG_B_BOXES = ảnh kết quả node BG_B_BOXES ở S14c_0 Setup; IMG_CS_DOROTHY = ảnh kết quả node CS_DOROTHY ở S14c_0 Setup; IMG_ACA_SET = ảnh thật (xem doc mục 2); IMG_CS_GLORIA_2 = ảnh kết quả node CS_GLORIA_2 ở S14c_0 Setup; IMG_ACA_MACRO = ảnh thật (xem doc mục 2); IMG_CS_TERRANCE_2 = ảnh kết quả node CS_TERRANCE_2 ở S14c_0 Setup; IMG_PROP_SILICONE = ảnh kết quả node PROP_SILICONE ở S14c_0 Setup. Chạy: ảnh F_ (xem khung) → clip T_/V_ → TAI. Clip có thoại: Omni nói để khớp miệng, dựng thay bằng giọng ElevenLabs.

nodes.prompt: Top shot, 4 seconds, one continuous shot, no cuts. The image is the start frame; the shot begins exactly on it. Camera: standing on a tripod, locked off, no movement. Physics: real weight and balance; people move at a real-time pace. Object lock: every utensil, bowl, plate, glass, brochure and prop in the picture is a rigid solid object that keeps exactly the same shape, size, length, color and number of pieces from the first frame to the last; nothing bends, stretches, melts, warps, splits, merges, multiplies, morphs or turns into something else; nothing appears, disappears or swaps places. The wooden pieces stay lit by the same light as everything else, with real shadows; exactly the same number of wooden pieces as in the start frame. Action: The seven wooden utensils lie still on the red-and-white checkered towel; only the daylight shifts a little across them. Living layer: the daylight shifts a little across the wood. Nobody speaks; mouths stay closed or only show expressions. Real-time pace, nothing slow-motion. Picture: the start frame's natural look to the last second, same detail, grain, colors and exposure, never more detailed or softer; no plastic skin. Audio: no voice, no speech, no singing, no humming, no music; only quiet natural room sound: two wooden pieces touching softly. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.

Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the empty half-packed kitchen: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is the character sheet of the friend: use it only for the face, hair, glasses, jewelry and clothes. Image 3 is the real product photo of the wooden utensils. Medium shot. The photo shows the friend at the counter, one hand resting on a red-and-white checkered towel beside a row of the seven wooden utensils. The friend: a 73-year-old Black American woman, the grandmother's longtime neighbor from the same church: short natural silver hair, large round glasses, a calm face with quiet authority. She is just back from church: a moss-green dress, a matching cardigan with a small brooch, a canvas tote bag on her shoulder. The towel is one red-and-white checkered cotton kitchen towel (the same towel in every shot). ACAWOOD SET: solid deep-brown acacia wood utensils with visible natural grain, each carved from a single piece, matte oiled finish (not glossy, not varnished), a small hanging hole near the end of each handle. Exactly seven utensils in the full set: a ladle, a wok spatula, a slotted spoon, a turner, a serving spoon, a mixing spoon and a small spoon. The utensils keep the exact shape of the real product photo. Lighting match: the wooden utensils are lit by exactly the same light as the rest of the scene: the same direction, color temperature, softness and exposure, with soft highlights on the side facing the main light and matching shade on the far side, a soft contact shadow where they touch the counter, towel or a hand. The same grain, softness and color grade as the rest of the photo, the same perspective, and a realistic size (the ladle about 33 cm long). Use Image 3 only for the shapes, number, grain and color of the wood; ignore its lighting, background and shadows. It must look photographed together in one shot, never pasted in or cut out. Anyone holding something: the right number of fingers, a natural grip, exactly two arms and two hands per person, no extra hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: plain daylight in a lived-in kitchen, natural color. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Final check: the friend is the same person as in the character sheet, with the same clothes, glasses and jewelry. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
